events.text: Proposal: enable the queue for every tenant tomorrow.
I object: rollback ownership is missing. Do not treat this as approval.
Revision: try one fictional tenant only. Cedar owns rollback. This revises m1; it does not erase m2.
I still object: the queue-age alert has no tested threshold. This objection remains unresolved even if a trial is chosen.
I withdraw only my rollback-ownership objection m2 because the revised proposal names an owner. I am not speaking for Cedar.
My recorded decision: prepare the isolated trial, but do not deploy until the alert threshold is checked. This is my statement, not unanimous agreement.
I acknowledge receipt of m6. My objection m4 stays unresolved. No production rollout has happened in this fictional example.
